title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 102
description: Ten questions on Psalms 102: the prayer of one in distress, whose days fade like smoke, while Yahweh remains forever.

questions.text: Verse 1 says: "Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my ... come to you." What is missing?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you."

questions.text: What do the speaker's days consume away like?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "For my days consume away like smoke."

questions.text: Why is the speaker's heart withered like grass, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says his heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for he forgets to eat his bread.

answers.text: He forgets to eat his bread

questions.text: Which bird of the wilderness does the speaker compare himself to in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "I am like a pelican of the wilderness."

questions.text: How does the speaker describe himself in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he has become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

answers.text: Like a lion in its den
Like a deer by the stream
Like a sparrow alone on the housetop

questions.text: What has the speaker mixed his drink with?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears."

questions.text: On whom will Yahweh arise and have mercy, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "You will arise and have mercy on Zion."

questions.text: For whom will this be written, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: "This will be written for the generation to come."

questions.text: Why did Yahweh look down from heaven, according to verses 19-20?
questions.explanation: Verses 19-20 say he looked down to hear the groans of the prisoner and to free those condemned to death.

answers.text: To count all the stars of heaven
To measure the depth of the sea
To choose a new king for Zion
To hear the groans of the prisoner

questions.text: Verses 25-26 speak of the earth and the heavens. What will all of them wear out like?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 names the earth and the heavens, and verse 26 says all of them will wear out like a garment.
